business_problem: Endava uses Codex to scale senior engineering expertise across its full delivery lifecycle.
solution_summary: Endava uses Codex to scale senior engineering expertise across its full delivery lifecycle. Endava, a global software contracting firm with engineers across Europe, the Americas, and Asia, has been an early adopter of Codex. For a business built around shipping quality software for banks, insurers, retailers, and media companies, the improvements have been substantial. Endava now calls itself an agentic organization : a company where senior expertise is codified into agents that work alongside teams across the entire client engagement lifecycle, from intake to ideation and, finally, delivery. Codify your seniors. The largest leverage comes from capturing senior architects’ judgment in Codex, so junior team members get senior guidance as they execute.

solution_components.name: Codex
solution_components.role: Implements, tests, reviews, or proposes code changes so engineers can move faster with human oversight.
